question:
B. Is this measure already running in North Savo wellbeing services county (or in the KYS university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure reduce deaths among the people it reaches, and by how much?
Measure: Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit. Every current smoker with suspected lung cancer gets cessation medication and counselling at the first visit, as part of preparing for curative treatment.
effect_summary_en: In a Moscow cohort of 517 current smokers with early-stage NSCLC, quitting after diagnosis was linked to lower all-cause mortality (adjusted HR 0.67, 95% CI 0.53–0.85).
supported_en: A 2021 study in Annals of Internal Medicine reports an adjusted HR of 0.67 (0.53–0.85) for all-cause mortality after quitting in early-stage NSCLC; the county has published a model for raising smoking and giving quit-smoking advice.
not_supported_en: The study is observational, and no page shows how many patients a first-visit offer would get to quit.
in_use_quote: Pohjois-Savon tupakka- ja nikotiinivieroituksen toimintamalli on julkaistu. Mallin avulla otat tupakka- ja nikotiinituotteiden käytön puheeksi, annat tarvittaessa vierotusohjauksen ja teet tarvittavat toimenpidekirjaukset.
in_use_summary_en: Pohjois-Savo has published a county-wide model for tobacco and nicotine cessation (raise the subject, give quit-smoking advice when needed, record it), but the KYS lung cancer care chain only asks for pack-years on the referral.
missing_en: No page shows quit-smoking medicines and counselling started at the first KYS lung clinic visit for every smoker with suspected lung cancer.
summary_en: The Pohjois-Savo wellbeing services county has published a county-wide model for raising tobacco use and giving quit-smoking advice. The KYS lung cancer care chain only records pack-years, and no page shows quit-smoking medicines and counselling started at the first lung clinic visit. A 2021 Annals of Internal Medicine cohort found an adjusted HR of 0.67 (0.53–0.85) for death from any cause among early-stage NSCLC patients who quit after diagnosis.
unanswered_en: I found no page showing that KYS lung clinic patients are routinely given quit-smoking medicines or referred to a quit-smoking nurse.
